title: totani: analysis code for "Foreground dependence of the 20 GeV Galactic halo gamma-ray excess and its proposed connection to the LUX-ZEPLIN event"

creators.name: Abazajian, Kevork N.
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of California, Irvine

creators.name: Macias, Oscar
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics and Astronomy, San Francisco State University; GRAPPA Institute, University of Amsterdam

description: Analysis code of Abazajian, Li & Macias (2026): fifteen years of Fermi-LAT data at |l|, |b| ≤ 60° fitted on 10°, 2° and 1° cells against 281 Galactic diffuse-emission configurations, three Fermi-bubbles descriptions, four Loop I templates and the eROSITA bubbles, with an NFW annihilation template; simulated skies; and the scripts that produce every table and figure of the paper. The analysis-ready inputs (counts, exposure, PSF and template caches) are a separate Zenodo record linked from the README. GALPROP outputs are not redistributed; the Galp21 configurations are available from the authors on request. GALPROP: https://galprop.stanford.edu/
